name: Trinoline: Genesis
original_name: トリノライン：ジェネシス
source:
Fandisc for Trinoline. Contains stories for all the characters (including sub-characters Hanako and Ayaka). [url=/v15637]Soreyori no Prologue[/url] character poll winner Himeno Touwa's mini story is also included.

In a questionnary, minori asked for people to put what they want in. The [url=http://www.minori.ph/lineup/trinoline/_genesis_.html]questionnaires[/url] was open until May 22nd.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/01/01/january-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
Trinoline的Fandisc。包含所有角色（包括次要角色花子和绫香）的故事。[url=/v15637]Soreyori no Prologue[/url] 角色投票获胜者Himeno Touwa的迷你故事也包括在内。

在一份问卷中，minori要求人们输入他们想要的内容。[url=http://www.minori.ph/lineup/trinoline/_genesis_.html]问卷[/url]开放至5月22日。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/01/01/january-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
